snippet.title: Parasomnia Demo Trailer 3
snippet.description:
Parasomnia is an upcoming narrative focused, puzzle driven horror game by Nimbus Games set in a 1987 fictional Malaysian town. It tells the story of a pair of siblings getting caught up in a supernatural event after being called back to their childhood home.

Wishlist the game and download the demo on steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967220/Parasomnia/
